props.gloss_en: a knife with many notches is judged as a saw
with only one notch: if it catches (ogeret) -- invalid
if it entangles (mesuchsechet) -- valid
R' Eliezer: ogeret is [a notch] from two sides
R' Eliezer: mesuchsechet is [a notch] from one side
[the one-side notch is] where it stands at the head of the knife
where he drew [the knife] forward and did not bring it back
Rava: ogeret -- one may not slaughter, and if he did, his slaughter is invalid
Rava: mesuchsechet -- not ab initio, but if he slaughtered, his slaughter is valid
Rava: [a notch that] rises and falls in the knife -- one slaughters with it ab initio
(as Rav Ashi reported in Rava's name) mesuchsechet -- invalid
here [invalid] -- where he drew it forward and back
here [valid] -- where he drew it forward and did not bring it back
Rav Acha b. Rav Avya: [a knife] resembling a grain-awn -- what is [the law]?
Rav Ashi: who will give us of its meat, and we will eat
Rav Chisda: examining the knife is from the Torah, as it says 'and slaughter with this and eat' (I Sam 14:34)
we are speaking of [showing the knife] to a sage
R' Yochanan: they said to show the knife to a sage only because of the sage's honour
it is rabbinic, and the verse is a mere support (asmachta)
in the West they examine it in the sun
in Nehardea they examine it with water
Rav Sheshet examined it with the tip of his tongue
Rav Acha bar Yaakov examined it with a strand of hair
Sura: flesh it consumes, flesh shall examine it
the knife requires examination on the flesh and on the fingernail
and [the knife requires examination] on the three sides
Rav Yeimar: on the three sides it does not need [examination]
Shmuel: one who heated a knife white-hot and slaughtered with it -- his slaughter is valid, for its sharpness precedes its heat
the place of slaughter opens wide
Reish Lakish: there are three deficiencies -- of a bone in the pesach, of an ear in the firstborn, of a blemish in sacrifices
Rav Chisda: also the deficiency of a knife
and the other [Reish Lakish] -- he does not speak of non-sacred matters
and all of them -- their deficiency is as the deficiency of the altar
and how much is the altar's deficiency? enough for a fingernail to catch on it
R' Shimon b. Yochai: [the altar's deficiency is] a handbreadth
R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: an olive-bulk
this [the baraita's measures] -- in the limestone
this [the fingernail] -- in the stone
Rav Huna: a slaughterer who did not present the knife before a sage -- we ostracize him
Rava: we remove him and proclaim of his meat that it is tereifa
here [ostracism] -- where his knife was found good
here [removal and proclamation] -- where his knife was not found good
Ravina: where his knife was not found good, one smears [the meat] with dung, so that it is not sold even to gentiles
Rava bar Chinnana ostracized him, removed him, and proclaimed his meat tereifa
Rava bar Chinnana: let the Sages look into his matter, for little children depend on him
Rav Ashi examined his knife, it was found good, and he declared him [his meat] fit
Mar Zutra: and should the master not be concerned for the elder?
Rav Ashi: we are carrying out his agency
Rabba bar Huna: with a detached tooth one may slaughter ab initio
Rabba bar Huna: with a detached fingernail one may slaughter ab initio
the mishna: [all slaughter with anything] except ... the teeth, because they strangle
the mishna: [all slaughter with anything] except ... the fingernail, because they strangle
tooth against tooth -- no difficulty: this [Rabba bar Huna] with one, this [the mishna] with two
nail against nail -- no difficulty: this [Rabba bar Huna] detached, this [the mishna] attached

nodes.label_he: כאן שהוליך ולא הביא
nodes.label_en: here [valid] -- where he drew it forward and did not bring it back

nodes.label_he: דמיא לסאסא, מאי?
nodes.label_en: Rav Acha b. Rav Avya: [a knife] resembling a grain-awn -- what is [the law]?

nodes.label_he: מאן יהיב לן מבשריה ואכלינן
nodes.label_en: Rav Ashi: who will give us of its meat, and we will eat

nodes.label_he: מנין לבדיקת סכין מן התורה? שנאמר ושחטתם בזה ואכלתם
nodes.label_en: Rav Chisda: examining the knife is from the Torah, as it says 'and slaughter with this and eat' (I…

nodes.label_he: לחכם קאמרינן
nodes.label_en: we are speaking of [showing the knife] to a sage

nodes.label_he: לא אמרו להראות סכין לחכם אלא מפני כבודו של חכם
nodes.label_en: R' Yochanan: they said to show the knife to a sage only because of the sage's honour

nodes.label_he: מדרבנן, וקרא אסמכתא בעלמא הוא
nodes.label_en: it is rabbinic, and the verse is a mere support (asmachta)

nodes.label_he: במערבא בדקי לה בשימשא
nodes.label_en: in the West they examine it in the sun

nodes.label_he: בנהרדעא בדקו לה במיא
nodes.label_en: in Nehardea they examine it with water

nodes.label_he: רב ששת בדק לה בריש לישניה
nodes.label_en: Rav Sheshet examined it with the tip of his tongue

nodes.label_he: רב אחא בר יעקב בדק לה בחוט השערה
nodes.label_en: Rav Acha bar Yaakov examined it with a strand of hair

nodes.label_he: בישרא אכלה, בישרא לבדקה
nodes.label_en: Sura: flesh it consumes, flesh shall examine it

nodes.label_he: צריכא בדיקה אבישרא ואטופרא
nodes.label_en: the knife requires examination on the flesh and on the fingernail

nodes.label_he: ואתלתא רוחתא
nodes.label_en: and [the knife requires examination] on the three sides

nodes.label_he: אתלתא רוחתא לא צריכא
nodes.label_en: Rav Yeimar: on the three sides it does not need [examination]

nodes.label_he: ליבן סכין ושחט בה -- שחיטתו כשרה, שחידודה קודם לליבונה
nodes.label_en: Shmuel: one who heated a knife white-hot and slaughtered with it -- his slaughter is valid, for its…

nodes.label_he: בית השחיטה מרווח רווח
nodes.label_en: the place of slaughter opens wide

nodes.label_he: שלש פגימות הן: פגימת עצם בפסח, פגימת אוזן בבכור, פגימת מום בקדשים
nodes.label_en: Reish Lakish: there are three deficiencies -- of a bone in the pesach, of an ear in the firstborn,…

nodes.label_he: אף פגימת סכין
nodes.label_en: Rav Chisda: also the deficiency of a knife

nodes.label_he: ואידך -- בחולין לא קא מיירי
nodes.label_en: and the other [Reish Lakish] -- he does not speak of non-sacred matters

nodes.label_he: וכולן, פגימתן כדי פגימת המזבח
nodes.label_en: and all of them -- their deficiency is as the deficiency of the altar

nodes.label_he: וכמה פגימת המזבח? כדי שתחגור בה צפורן
nodes.label_en: and how much is the altar's deficiency? enough for a fingernail to catch on it

nodes.label_he: רבי שמעון בן יוחאי אומר: טפח
nodes.label_en: R' Shimon b. Yochai: [the altar's deficiency is] a handbreadth

nodes.label_he: רבי אליעזר בן יעקב אומר: כזית
nodes.label_en: R' Eliezer b. Yaakov: an olive-bulk

nodes.label_he: הא בסידא
nodes.label_en: this [the baraita's measures] -- in the limestone

nodes.label_he: הא באבנא
nodes.label_en: this [the fingernail] -- in the stone

nodes.label_he: האי טבחא דלא סר סכינא קמי חכם -- משמתינן ליה
nodes.label_en: Rav Huna: a slaughterer who did not present the knife before a sage -- we ostracize him

nodes.label_he: מעברינן ליה, ומכרזינן אבשריה דטרפה היא
nodes.label_en: Rava: we remove him and proclaim of his meat that it is tereifa

nodes.label_he: כאן -- בשנמצאת סכינו יפה
nodes.label_en: here [ostracism] -- where his knife was found good

nodes.label_he: כאן -- בשלא נמצאת סכינו יפה
nodes.label_en: here [removal and proclamation] -- where his knife was not found good

nodes.label_he: היכא דלא נמצאת סכינו יפה -- ממסמס ליה בפרתא, דאפילו לגוים נמי לא מזדבן
nodes.label_en: Ravina: where his knife was not found good, one smears [the meat] with dung, so that it is not sold…

nodes.label_he: שמתיה ועבריה, ואכריז אבשריה דטרפה היא
nodes.label_en: Rava bar Chinnana ostracized him, removed him, and proclaimed his meat tereifa

nodes.label_he: ליעיינו רבנן במלתיה, דתלו ביה טפלי
nodes.label_en: Rava bar Chinnana: let the Sages look into his matter, for little children depend on him

nodes.label_he: בדקה רב אשי לסכיניה, ונמצאת יפה, ואכשריה
nodes.label_en: Rav Ashi examined his knife, it was found good, and he declared him [his meat] fit

nodes.label_he: ולא ליחוש מר לסבא?
nodes.label_en: Mar Zutra: and should the master not be concerned for the elder?

nodes.label_he: שליחותיה קא עבדינן
nodes.label_en: Rav Ashi: we are carrying out his agency

nodes.label_he: שן תלושה... מותר לשחוט בה לכתחלה
nodes.label_en: Rabba bar Huna: with a detached tooth one may slaughter ab initio

nodes.label_he: וצפורן תלושה מותר לשחוט בה לכתחלה
nodes.label_en: Rabba bar Huna: with a detached fingernail one may slaughter ab initio

nodes.label_en: the mishna: [all slaughter with anything] except ... the fingernail, because they strangle

nodes.label_en: nail against nail -- no difficulty: this [Rabba bar Huna] detached, this [the mishna] attached
